purpose: Controlled evidence contract for moving from S3 implementation toward S4 empirical validation.
non_negotiable: forecast data is immutable and never overwritten
measured telemetry retains source and retrieval provenance
forecast, measured, calculated, modelled, estimated and proxy values remain distinct
water-quality evidence requires QMS/laboratory provenance before verification
GHG claims require activity data, emission factor, methodology and uncertainty
blockchain anchoring proves evidence integrity and does not replace source verification
release_rule: No P15/P16 promotion until all mandatory S4 evidence categories have reviewable evidence.
